input.form_text: MESA MBA C4 | TERM 2 | CASE 3 | INBOUND APPLICATION 1 OF 10 All In Capital — Application Form Response Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them. Pair with the applicant's deck (Application_01_StockSathi_Deck.pptx). Company Company name StockSathi (StockSathi Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) Website www.stocksathi.example Location Hyderabad, Telangana Incorporated March 2026 One-line description B2B restocking app with short-term credit for small-town kirana stores. Sector (as selected) Consumer tech Stage (as selected) Pre-seed Team size 4 (2 founders, 2 field agents) Founders Founder 1 Aarav Deshmukh, CEO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aarav-deshmukh-example Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years. Ran a regional sales team at a large distributor. Founder 2 Pooja Nair, CTO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/pooja-nair-example Background: Software engineer at a payments company, 5 years. Built the ordering app and our credit-scoring rules. Time commitment Both full-time since April 2026. Prior startup experience None for either founder. Equity split Founders 85%, angels 15%. ESOP pool to be created. Product and traction What have you built? A vernacular Android app for store owners to order from partner distributors, with next-morning delivery and 7 to 14 days credit for repeat customers. Live in Karimnagar only. Active customers 42 retailers onboarded, 22 of whom have ordered more than once. Revenue / GMV GMV of about INR 9 lakh in the last three months. Revenue is trade margin of about 4% plus a credit fee on credit orders. Growth GMV has grown every month since the July launch. Repeat behaviour Repeat customers reorder about once a week. Customer acquisition Two field agents visit stores and onboard them. Word of mouth between neighbouring stores has helped. Our CAC is under INR 2,000 per store. Unit economics Positive contribution on delivered orders once a store has ordered twice. Credit How is credit funded? Credit is provided through our NBFC partner. We take the first-loss risk. Credit book size About INR 85,000 outstanding across 12 retailers. Defaults to date None so far. We follow up personally on late payments. Regulatory status Not registered as an NBFC. Competition and differentiation Who else is doing this? Large B2B marketplaces and local wholesale markets. Why will you win? We focus only on small towns and speak the owner's language, literally and in how we assess credit. Fundraising Amount raising INR 2 Cr Valuation expectation INR 12 Cr post-money Existing investors Three angels from the FMCG and logistics industry, INR 25 lakh in total. Use of funds Credit book, hiring, expansion to two more towns. Other investors in conversation One pre-seed fund. No term sheet yet. How did you hear about us? Introduction through a founder in your Fund I portfolio. Anything else we should know? We have been told our credit-scoring approach is an edge. Happy to walk you through it on a call. We would also welcome your help with introductions to NBFCs.
